grid.statement: fedoo.constitutivelaw.ElastoPlasticity(young_modulus, poisson_ratio, yield_stress, name='') is a J2 elasto-plastic constitutive law with isotropic hardening (local return mapping, n_statev=7, statev = [P, EP(6)]); hardening is defined via set_hardening_function(function_type, **kwargs)
ElastoPlasticity does NOT implement the plane-stress ('2Dstress') return mapping; for plane-stress models use a Simcoon plasticity law, e.g. fedoo.constitutivelaw.Simcoon("EPICP", props)
fedoo.constitutivelaw.Simcoon("EPICP", props) with props = np.array([E, nu, alpha, Re, k, m]) gives isotropic plasticity with power law hardening sigma = k*eps_p**m

Standard workflow: fd.ModelingSpace("2Dplane"); mesh = fd.mesh.rectangle_mesh(nx=41, ny=21, x_min=0, x_max=L, y_min=0, y_max=h, elm_type="quad4", name="Domain"); wf = fd.weakform.StressEquilibrium("ConstitutiveLaw", nlgeom=False); fd.Assembly.create(wf, "Domain", "quad4", name="Assembling"); pb = fd.problem.NonLinear("Assembling")
